checks.text: The page heading is "Family Calendar" and the default view is the month grid for the current month, with the tab labelled "Week" visible and inactive.

In the month view, clicking the button "Add event" opens a form; typing "Dentist" in the field labelled "Title", "2025-06-10" in the field labelled "Date", "14:00" in the field labelled "Time", and clicking "Save" adds a cell in the June 10 column that contains "Dentist" and "14:00".
Switching to the tab labelled "Week" shows the week containing June 10, 2025, and the day column for Tuesday June 10 contains the text "Dentist" and "14:00".

In the event form, selecting "Weekly" in the select labelled "Repeat" and saving an event titled "Yoga" on "2025-06-12" at "09:00" creates events on June 12, June 19, and June 26, 2025, each showing "Yoga" and "09:00" in the month grid.
Clicking the button "Export ICS" produces a downloadable file whose content includes the line "SUMMARY:Dentist" and the line "DTSTART:20250610T140000".

In the tab labelled "Tasks", typing "Buy milk" in the field labelled "New task" and clicking "Add" adds a checklist item with the text "Buy milk" and an unchecked checkbox; the progress indicator shows "0/1".
Checking the checkbox next to "Buy milk" changes the progress indicator to "1/1" and strikes through the text "Buy milk".
Clicking the button "Delete Dentist" on the event in the month grid removes the "Dentist" entry from June 10, and the week view for that week no longer contains "Dentist".
Reload keeps the event "Dentist" on June 10, 2025, and the task "Buy milk" with its checked state, visible in the month grid and the Tasks tab respectively.
